Descrizione Integrato nel cuore di una grande istituzione riconosciuta, l’ospedale dell’Institution de Lavigny è uno dei centri di riferimento romandi per i pazienti affetti da lesioni cerebrali che necessitano di riabilitazione neurologica, o che soffrono di epilessia difficile da trattare. Aperto dal 1° luglio 2024, il Servizio universitario di neuroriabilitazione (SUN) è una struttura innovativa che collega due istituzioni, il CHUV e l’Hôpital de Lavigny. Con 75 letti e quasi 200 collaboratori, il SUN fornisce interventi altamente specializzati e interdisciplinari in neuroriabilitazione accademica, per oltre 500 pazienti ricoverati e quasi 2000 pazienti ambulatoriali all’anno. È in questo contesto che il dipartimento ospedaliero si sviluppa, mantenendo vive le valori a lui cari: - La benevolenza, l’equità, il rispetto e la responsabilità in un approccio manageriale collaborativo
• Offriamo l’opportunità di scoprire un lavoro appassionante in neuro-riabilitazione, al centro dell’interdisciplinarità, in un rapporto di partnership con i pazienti e i loro cari. Posti disponibili All’interno del team di cure del Dipartimento Ospedaliero di Lavigny, cerchiamo: - Infermiere/i a 80-100% CDI, 80% a 100% Descrizione del ruolo

• Profilo ricercato - Una formazione di infermiere/i HES o in cure generali, o titolo ritenuto equivalente - Competenze nel lavorare in interdisciplinarità - Un’esperienza in neurologia e riabilitazione o un interesse a formarsi in questo campo - La formazione di praticante formatore/trice e/o di formatore/trice in azienda rappresenta un vantaggio - Buona capacità di adattamento e senso di responsabilità

Description Integrated within a renowned large institution, the Lavigny Institution’s hospital is one of the key centers in the Romandy region for patients with brain injuries requiring neurological rehabilitation, or suffering from difficult-to-treat epilepsy. Open since July 1, 2024, the University Neurorehabilitation Service (SUN) is an innovative structure linking two institutions, the CHUV and Lavigny Hospital. With 75 beds and nearly 200 staff members, SUN provides highly specialized and interdisciplinary care in academic neurorehabilitation, serving over 500 hospitalized patients and nearly 2000 outpatient patients annually. Within this framework, the hospital department is expanding while maintaining the core values close to us: - Benevolence, fairness, respect, and responsibility within a collaborative management approach
• We offer the opportunity to discover exciting work in neuro-rehabilitation, at the heart of interdisciplinarity, in partnership with patients and their families. Positions Available Within the care team of the Lavigny Hospital Department, we are seeking: - Registered Nurses (80-100% CDI), 80% to 100% Job Description
• Your responsibilities: - Organize and deliver nursing care consistent with the clinical pathway of patients undergoing neurological rehabilitation, in collaboration with the entire interdisciplinary team, and in partnership with hospitalized patients and their families - Incorporate the patient’s rehabilitation goals into daily care - Perform medical acts, usually delegated to healthcare staff upon medical prescription - Inform, guide, and advise patients and their families - Initiate and participate in health education and promotion measures in collaboration with the interdisciplinary team - Contribute to the training and development of colleagues, nursing students, interns, apprentices, and auxiliary staff
• Profile Sought - A qualification as a HES nurse or in general care, or an equivalent qualification - Skills in working in an interdisciplinary environment - Experience in neurology and rehabilitation or an interest in training in this field - Training as a trainer or in-company trainer is an advantage - Good adaptability and sense of responsibility What We Offer - 12-hour shifts - Training and/or development opportunities - A salary aligned with the role, according to the collective agreement in the Vaud public healthcare sector - Social benefits of a large institution, cafeteria, free parking, public transport services - A stimulating and passionate job within an institution belonging to the Vaud neuro-rehabilitation sector, recognized for the quality and diversity of its services, which remains human-sized despite its broad mission - The opportunity to showcase professional skills in an interdisciplinary manner where each skill is valued and recognized - Membership in a committed and motivated team and the chance to contribute to quality care improvement projects in an environment where human dignity remains central - The possibility to face many exciting challenges within a growing structure, in close collaboration with an engaged, committed, and caring management team Additional Information - Start date: As soon as possible or to be agreed - Application deadline: June 16, 2026 - Contact: Mrs. Sofia Cruz, Care Department Manager, sofia.cruz@ilavigny.ch, 021 821 45 45 Application Interested in taking on this challenge? We look forward to receiving your complete application file (cover letter, CV, copies of diplomas and work certificates). Descrizione Dislocata su più sedi, l'Institution de Lavigny è costituita da un ospedale neurologico con consultazioni ambulatoriali su due sedi, da un dipartimento di accoglienza per persone adulte con disabilità, con deficit intellettivi o problematiche fisiche, da una scuola specializzata e da un settore di laboratori e formazione professionale. Il dipartimento Plein Soleil a Losanna è una struttura unica nel Canton Vaud dedicata alle persone con disabilità, affette da malattie neurologiche o lesioni cerebrali. Propone un alloggio in RSA con servizi socio-educativi, laboratori di sviluppo personale, accoglienza diurna in CAT o in alloggi protetti, e un centro di terapie ambulatoriali. Desideri combinare visione strategica e leadership al servizio della qualità della vita delle persone assistite? Vuoi svolgere un ruolo chiave nell’evoluzione del settore assistenza e contribuire a strutturare un’organizzazione significativa? Mansioni - Fornire una visione a medio e lungo termine del settore assistenza, anticipando le principali evoluzioni e le sfide legate alla dipendenza, alle risorse umane e alla trasformazione delle pratiche. - Progettare e far evolvere l’organizzazione delle cure per garantire coerenza, fluidità, qualità e adattamento alle esigenze del territorio. - Strutturare processi decisionali chiari ed efficaci, rafforzando la leggibilità e le performance del funzionamento istituzionale. - Assicurare una coordinazione fluida tra direzione, quadri, team e partner istituzionali. - Contribuire alle decisioni della direzione e alla strategia dell’istituzione. - Allocare risorse in linea con le priorità del territorio. - Posizionare il settore assistenza come attore chiave del progetto istituzionale. - Articolare continuamente la visione strategica e la realtà operativa. - Costruire una governance medico-infermieristica con i medici in logica di co-responsabilità. - Promuovere un’assistenza interdisciplinare coerente centrata sul residente. - Contribuire alla qualità delle interazioni con i diversi partner. - Stimolare una dinamica di leadership tra gli IRES, accompagnandoli verso una postura di manager autonomi, solidi e influenti nella loro pratica quotidiana. - Far crescere i quadri di prossimità nella loro postura, capacità decisionale e impatto sul territorio. - Contribuire a creare un ambiente di lavoro stabile, significativo e coeso. - Agire sulla cultura organizzativa per rafforzare l’impegno dei team in un contesto di management collaborativo.

Description Located across multiple sites, the Institution de Lavigny comprises a neurological hospital with outpatient consultations on two sites, a residential department for adults with disabilities, including intellectual or physical impairments, a specialized school, and a sector of workshops and vocational training. The Plein Soleil department in Lausanne is a unique establishment in the Canton of Vaud dedicated to people with disabilities, suffering from neurological diseases or brain injuries. It offers accommodation in a nursing home with socio-educational services, personal development workshops, day care in day centers or protected housing, and an outpatient therapy center. Do you want to combine strategic vision and leadership to enhance the quality of life for the residents? Do you want to play a key role in the evolution of the care sector and help structure a meaningful organization?
• Responsibilities - Provide a medium- and long-term vision for the care sector, anticipating major developments and challenges related to dependency, human resources, and practice transformation. - Design and evolve care organization to ensure coherence, fluidity, quality, and responsiveness to field needs. - Establish clear and effective decision-making processes, enhancing transparency and institutional performance. - Ensure smooth coordination between management, supervisors, teams, and institutional partners. - Contribute to management decisions and institutional strategy. - Allocate resources aligned with field priorities. - Position the care sector as a key actor in the institutional project. - Continuously align strategic vision with operational realities. - Build a medico-nursing governance with physicians based on shared responsibility. - Promote coherent interdisciplinary care centered on the resident. - Improve the quality of interactions with various partners. - Drive leadership among IRES, supporting them toward autonomous, strong, and influential management practices. - Develop proximity managers in decision-making, posture, and impact. - Contribute to creating a stable, meaningful, and unifying work environment. - Influence organizational culture to strengthen team engagement within a collaborative management framework.
• Requirements - Proven experience in managing care teams, with at least level N 2 responsibility, in a medico-social or healthcare environment, ideally in a nursing home. - Higher management certification, university training in health institution management, or master's in health systems management or health economics. - Strong experience in strategic and organizational leadership, system management, and change management, with a federative leadership style fostering interdisciplinary collaboration and stakeholder partnership. What We Offer - A stimulating, caring, and collaborative interdisciplinary work environment. - A varied, high-responsibility role with concrete and strategic missions impacting the development of the care sector. - The opportunity to play a key role in evolving managerial and organizational practices closely linked to the field. - Continuous training opportunities, internal and external, to develop your skills and advance your career. - Attractive salary conditions in accordance with the Vaud public health sector collective agreement, recognizing your expertise and commitment. - Willing to learn, share, and evolve with the team and the people welcomed.

- Firmenrestaurant, das verschiedene Mahlzeiten zu reduzierten Preisen anbietet, in einer angenehmen beruflichen Umgebung, die den Austausch fördert.
- Eine breite Palette an Sport- und Entspannungsaktivitäten (Yoga, Fitness, Aquagym, Pilates usw.) und Massagen sowie regelmäßige Firmenevents.
